common.gprop:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: furniture sprite for a 2:1 isometric pixel-art office game; it will be downscaled exactly 8x to final pixel art
Style/medium: crisp pixel art in the style of Image 2 (style only, do not copy its content): clean chunky pixels, one-art-pixel dark plum outline, 3-tone cel shading per material, cozy pastel palette, no dithering, no gradients, no blur
Lighting: soft light from DIRECTLY ABOVE. Top faces are the brightest; the two visible side faces share the SAME mid tone (symmetric shading, because the sprite will also be used horizontally mirrored). No cast shadows.
Background: fully transparent background (alpha). If transparency is impossible, use a perfectly flat solid {key} background.
Avoid: floor, ground plane, grid, shadows on the ground, text, letters, numbers, logos, people, extra objects, any change of camera angle
